caption: The drawing depicts a metallic, conical, tiered object resembling an old stove or furnace, standing on three short legs. The object consists of stacked cylindrical sections that taper toward the top, which ends in a narrower cylindrical opening. It has two hinged metal doors with latches, positioned at different heights along the front, and a circular tray extending from the base, also supported by a leg. The stove is rendered in shades of brown and dark metallic gray, with highlights and shadows indicating its three-dimensional form and metal surface. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional objects or context.
title: Cannon Stove
